license_required.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter.

moral_character_required.quote: Have a professional record that indicates that the applicant has not committed any act or engaged in any conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action against a licensee under this chapter.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine from an approved school of medicine
degree_required.quote: Graduate from an approved school of medicine or receive a medical education that the board deems to be of equivalent quality.

accrediting_body.value: Association of American Medical Colleges, Association of Canadian Medical Colleges, or American Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: any school or college offering a course of study that, on successful completion, results in the degree of doctor of medicine and whose course of study has been approved or accredited by an educational or professional association, recognized by the board, including the association of American medical colleges, the association of Canadian medical colleges or the American medical association.

degree_level.quote: Graduate from an approved school of medicine or receive a medical education that the board deems to be of equivalent quality.

school_approval_basis.quote: whose course of study has been approved or accredited by an educational or professional association, recognized by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Graduate from an approved school of medicine or receive a medical education that the board deems to be of equivalent quality.

required.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program.

experience_source.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program.

duration.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program.

kind.value: approved hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program
kind.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: All three steps required; Steps 1 and 2 before initial licensure, Step 3 with a scaled score of at least 75, all within a seven-year period.
exams.quote: has passed steps one and two of the United States medical licensing examination... eligible for licensure as a doctor of medicine upon successful passage of step three of the United States medical licensing examination with a scaled score of at least seventy-five if the applicant has passed all three steps within a seven year period.

exams.name: Special Purpose Licensing Examination (SPEX)
exams.notes: May be required for endorsement applicants whose most recent qualifying exam precedes application by more than ten years, or for inactive licensees returning to practice.
exams.quote: "Special purpose licensing examination" means an examination that is developed by the national board of medical examiners on behalf of the federation of state medical boards for use by state licensing boards to test the basic medical competence of physicians who are applying for licensure and who have been in practice for a considerable period of time in another jurisdiction

interval_years.quote: each person holding an active license to practice medicine in this state shall renew the license every other year on or before the licensee's birthday

required.quote: A person who holds an active license to practice medicine in this state shall satisfy a continuing medical education requirement that is designed to provide the necessary understanding of current developments, skills, procedures or treatment related to the practice of medicine in such amount and during such period as the board establishes by rule.

available.quote: An applicant who is licensed in another jurisdiction... is eligible to be licensed to engage in the practice of medicine in this state through endorsement

requirements.value: Applicant must meet basic requirements of section 32-1422 and have passed one of several recognized examination combinations including the USMLE, FLEX, or NBME parts.
requirements.quote: An applicant who is licensed in another jurisdiction or whose license under this chapter has been revoked or surrendered or has expired and who meets the applicable requirements prescribed in section 32-1422, 32-1423 or 32-1424, has paid the fees required by this chapter and has filed a completed application found by the board to be true and correct is eligible to be licensed to engage in the practice of medicine in this state through endorsement

national_certification.quote: The applicant is certified by the national board of medical examiners or its successor entity as having successfully passed all three parts of the United States medical licensing examination or its successor examination.

national_association.value: Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC); American Medical Association (AMA)
national_association.quote: including the association of American medical colleges, the association of Canadian medical colleges or the American medical association.

regulatory_model.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter.

title_protection.quote: The use of the designation "M.D." in a way that would lead the public to believe that a person was licensed to practice medicine in this state.

scope_protection.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any federal or state laws, rules or regulations applicable to the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any federal or state laws, rules or regulations applicable to the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally disclosing a professional secret or privileged communication except as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally disclosing a professional secret or intentionally disclosing a privileged communication except as either act may otherwise be required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading advertising by a doctor of medicine or the doctor of medicine's staff, employer or representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a felony, whether or not involving moral turpitude, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate records on a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate records on a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exhibiting a pattern of using or being under the influence of alcohol or drugs while practicing medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibiting a pattern of using or being under the influence of alcohol or drugs or a similar substance while practicing medicine or to the extent that judgment may be impaired and the practice of medicine detrimentally affected.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using controlled substances except as prescribed by another physician for a course of treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using controlled substances except if prescribed by another physician for use during a prescribed course of treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances to immediate family members.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances to members of the physician's immediate family.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or administering any controlled substance or prescription-only drug for other than accepted therapeutic purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering any controlled substance or prescription-only drug for other than accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid except as specifically provided by statute.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except as provided in sections 32-1491 and 32-3248.03.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank, undated or predated prescription form.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a blank, undated or predated prescription form.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross malpractice, repeated malpractice or any malpractice resulting in the death of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing conduct that the board determines is gross malpractice, repeated malpractice or any malpractice resulting in the death of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that an incurable disease can be permanently cured, or that any condition can be cured by a secret method.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing that a manifestly incurable disease or infirmity can be permanently cured, or that any disease, ailment or infirmity can be cured by a secret method, procedure, treatment, medicine or device, if this is not true.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to divulge to the board the means, method, procedure, or treatment used in the care of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to divulge to the board on demand the means, method, procedure, modality of treatment or medicine used in the treatment of a disease, injury, ailment or infirmity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having action taken against a doctor by another licensing or regulatory jurisdiction due to incompetence or unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having action taken against a doctor of medicine by another licensing or regulatory jurisdiction due to that doctor of medicine's mental or physical inability to engage safely in the practice of medicine or the doctor of medicine's medical incompetence or for unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having sanctions imposed by a federal agency restricting or removing a person from the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having sanctions imposed by an agency of the federal government, including restricting, suspending, limiting or removing a person from the practice of medicine or restricting that person's ability to obtain financial remuneration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of the patient or the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of the patient or the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a formal order, probation, consent agreement or stipulation issued by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a formal order, probation, consent agreement or stipulation issued or entered into by the board or its executive director under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license or license renewal by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice medicine or a license renewal by fraud, by misrepresentation or by knowingly taking advantage of the mistake of another person or an agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or claiming to be a medical specialist if not true.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or claiming to be a medical specialist if this is not true.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a professional connection with or lending one's name to enhance the activities of an illegal practitioner of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Maintaining a professional connection with or lending one's name to enhance or continue the activities of an illegal practitioner of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish information in a timely manner to the board when legally requested.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish information in a timely manner to the board or the board's investigators or representatives if legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to allow authorized board personnel to examine documents, reports and records related to the physician's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to allow properly authorized board personnel on demand to examine and have access to documents, reports and records maintained by the physician that relate to the physician's medical practice or medically related activities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging a fee for services not rendered or dividing a professional fee for patient referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging a fee for services not rendered or dividing a professional fee for patient referrals among health care providers or health care institutions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or collecting a clearly excessive fee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging or collecting a clearly excessive fee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using experimental forms of diagnosis and treatment without adequate informed patient consent or conforming to accepted criteria.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using experimental forms of diagnosis and treatment without adequate informed patient consent, and without conforming to generally accepted experimental criteria

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual conduct with a current patient or with a former patient within six months after the last medical consultation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual conduct with a current patient or with a former patient within six months after the last medical consultation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that a doctor is boarded or board certified if not true or current, without the full name of the certifying entity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a representation by a doctor of medicine or the doctor of medicine's staff, employer or representative that the doctor of medicine is boarded or board certified if this is not true or the standing is not current or without supplying the full name of the specific agency, organization or entity granting this standing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to a body fluid examination as required by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to a body fluid examination or any other examination known to detect the presence of alcohol or other drugs as required by the board pursuant to section 32-1452 or pursuant to a board investigation into a doctor of medicine's alleged substance abuse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report evidence that a doctor of medicine is medically incompetent, guilty of unprofessional conduct, or unable to safely practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report in writing to the Arizona medical board or the Arizona regulatory board of physician assistants any evidence that a doctor of medicine or a physician assistant is or may be medically incompetent, guilty of unprofessional conduct or mentally or physically unable to safely practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing conduct the board determines is gross negligence, repeated negligence or negligence resulting in harm or death of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing conduct that the board determines is gross negligence, repeated negligence or negligence resulting in harm to or the death of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or furnishing a prescription medication to a person without first conducting a physical or mental health status examination or establishing a doctor-patient relationship.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or furnishing a prescription medication or a prescription-only device as defined in section 32-1901 to a person unless the licensee first conducts a physical or mental health status examination of that person or has previously established a doctor-patient relationship.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing office-based surgery using sedation in violation of board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing office-based surgery using sedation in violation of board rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this state.

definition_quote.value: The diagnosis, the treatment or the correction of or the attempt or the claim to be able to diagnose, treat or correct any and all human diseases, injuries, ailments, infirmities or deformities, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means, methods, devices or instrumentalities.
definition_quote.quote: Means the diagnosis, the treatment or the correction of or the attempt or the claim to be able to diagnose, treat or correct any and all human diseases, injuries, ailments, infirmities or deformities, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means, methods, devices or instrumentalities, except as the same may be among the acts or persons not affected by this chapter.

methods_authorized.quote: Includes the practice of medicine alone or the practice of surgery alone, or both.

drug_authority.value: A doctor of medicine may dispense drugs and devices kept by the doctor subject to labeling, recordkeeping, storage requirements, and registration with the board. May not dispense a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid except for an implantable device or for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders.
drug_authority.quote: Except as provided in subsections B and F of this section, a doctor of medicine may dispense drugs and devices kept by the doctor

license_status_types.quote: "Active license" means a valid and existing license to practice medicine... "Teaching license" means a valid license to practice medicine as a full-time faculty member

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Must hold a standard ECFMG certificate, complete a fifth pathway program, or serve 36 months as full-time assistant professor or higher in an approved school of medicine; must complete 36 months total of approved hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship (vs. 12 months for domestic graduates).
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Hold a standard certificate issued by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates, complete a fifth pathway program as provided in section 32-1424, subsection A, or complete thirty-six months as a full-time assistant professor or in a higher position in an approved school of medicine.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: A doctor may not dispense a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid that is for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders. Prescribing schedule II amphetamines and similar sympathomimetic drugs for exogenous obesity is limited to 30 days in any one year.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A doctor of medicine may not dispense a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid that is for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physical or mental health status examination may be conducted through telehealth with a clinical evaluation appropriate for the patient and the condition, except for examinations for written certification for medical marijuana purposes.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The physical or mental health status examination may be conducted through telehealth as defined in section 36-3601 with a clinical evaluation that is appropriate for the patient and the condition with which the patient presents, unless the examination is for the purpose of obtaining a written certification from the physician for the purposes of title 36, chapter 28.1.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Beginning September 1, 2017, applicants for expedited licensure pursuant to section 32-3241 shall submit a full set of fingerprints to the board for the purpose of obtaining a state and federal criminal records check

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A person renewing an active license to practice medicine in this state shall provide to the board as part of the renewal process a report of disciplinary actions, restrictions or any other action placed on or against that person's license or practice by another state licensing or disciplinary board or an agency of the federal government.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief executive officer, the medical director or the medical chief of staff of a health care institution shall inform the board if the privileges of a doctor to practice in that health care institution are denied, revoked, suspended or limited because of actions by the doctor

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish a confidential program for the treatment and rehabilitation of doctors of medicine who are licensed pursuant to this chapter and physician assistants who are licensed pursuant to chapter 25 of this title and who are impaired by alcohol or drug abuse.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board or, if delegated by the board, the executive director shall require, at the doctor's expense, any combination of mental, physical or oral or written medical competency examinations and conduct necessary investigations

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a registration to allow a doctor of medicine who is not a licensee to provide locum tenens medical services to substitute for or temporarily assist a doctor of medicine who holds an active license pursuant to this chapter
